meta.title: EIDOS — Every idea has a shape
meta.description: Give Claude a PDF, a photo of a whiteboard or a question; get back a world you can scroll through, verify, and that grows with you.
error.EIDOS_E_NO_KEY: This deployment is in Demo Mode. Explore the Atlas or add your own key in Settings.
error.EIDOS_E_PDF_TOO_BIG: Your PDF exceeds the maximum size ({max} MB). Try a single chapter.
error.EIDOS_E_PDF_TOO_LONG: Your PDF has {pages} pages; the maximum is {max}.
error.EIDOS_E_PDF_UNREADABLE: We couldn't open this PDF. Is it password-protected?
error.EIDOS_E_URL_UNREACHABLE: Claude couldn't read that page. It may need JavaScript or block automated readers.
error.EIDOS_E_REFUSAL: Claude can't help with this source or topic. Try another one.
error.EIDOS_E_OVERLOADED: Claude is very busy right now. Retry this step in a few seconds.
error.EIDOS_E_RATE_LIMIT: You've forged many worlds in a row. Wait a few minutes.
error.EIDOS_E_BUDGET: This deployment reached today's limit. Explore the Atlas or use your own key.
error.EIDOS_E_TRUNCATED: Claude's answer was cut off. Retrying with more room…
error.EIDOS_E_SCHEMA: Something went wrong structuring the world. Retry this step.
error.EIDOS_E_WEB_DISABLED: Web search is unavailable; Claude will explain from general knowledge.
error.EIDOS_E_TIMEOUT: Forging took too long. We kept what was built so far.
error.EIDOS_E_IMAGE: That image isn't valid. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB.
error.EIDOS_E_UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
